obligations: Expose an alertdialog toast with an alert content announcement.

behavior: ToastProvider and useToast expose a stable Core queue facade while RAC owns bounded visibility, pause/resume timing, announcements, focus, and portal lifecycle.

Toast declaratively enqueues one notification inside its provider; timeout and explicit removal settle each accepted dismissal callback at most once, while declarative replacement and provider teardown clear callbacks silently.
accessibility: Use RAC's alertdialog toast, linked title and description, and alert content announcement semantics.
Keep dismiss controls keyboard accessible and the toast region outside overlay hiding.
